teams.body: Beno Obano is set to become the latest England international to sacrifice his Test career by moving to the Top 14. teams.heading: Gonzalo Quesada banned following World Rugby’s new match official abuse process
teams.body: Italy head coach Gonzalo Quesada has become the first coach suspended under World Rugby's recently implemented Match Official Abuse Sanctioning Process. The governing body handed the Argentine a two-Test ban following his criticism of referee Luc Ramos after the July defeat to the All Blacks. Under the new framework, which targets comments that undermine public confidence in officials, Quesada is prohibited from all match-day proceedings, including stadium attendance, for upcoming fixtures. He retains the right to appeal the decision.

teams.heading: Japan Brave Blossoms faced Canada in the JRFU 100th anniversary match
teams.body: Japan hosted Canada at Denka Big Swan Stadium in Niigata City on Saturday. The fixture served as a celebration of the JRFU’s 100th anniversary. teams.heading: Ardie Savea ruled out of fourth Test with shoulder injury
teams.body: All Blacks captain Ardie Savea will miss the final Test of the Rugby’s Greatest Rivalry series in Baltimore after sustaining a shoulder injury in Saturday’s defeat at FNB Stadium. Head coach Dave Rennie confirmed the blow, stating, “He certainly won’t be travelling to the States.” While Rennie expressed frustration over the 29-24 result, he maintained that the gap between the two sides remains small, adding, “I’m really proud of the effort, our boys worked bloody hard tonight.”

teams.heading: Rassie Erasmus confirms Cheslin Kolbe ruled out following broken jaw injury
teams.body: The Springboks will be without Cheslin Kolbe for the final Test in Baltimore after head coach Rassie Erasmus confirmed the fullback suffered a broken jaw during Saturday’s 29-24 victory in Soweto. Kolbe was forced off in the ninth minute of the series-defining match. Erasmus also noted that Ben-Jason Dixon remains sidelined with concussion symptoms. Despite the injury setbacks, the victory leaves the world champions with a 2-1 series lead as they prepare for the finale against the All Blacks.
